name: CEO
purpose: Ředitel: převádí zadání majitele (board) na výsledky, deleguje na vedoucí, hlídá cíle a termíny, jako jediný kontaktuje majitele a s Asistentem vedení vede páteční board meeting.

schedules.name: CEO: pondělní plán
schedules.title: CEO: pondělní plán
schedules.notes:
Purpose: start the week with a plan the heads can act on. Source: the CEO's Monday routine.

Follow the section 'Monday plan' in your instructions: goals (goal_list), last week's board notes, open work per head; at most 5 priorities, each with an owner and a date; message each head once.
schedules.definition_of_done: Priorities for the week are written in a note (topic board) and every head with a priority got one message.

schedules.name: CEO: podklady pro board
schedules.title: CEO: podklady pro board
schedules.notes:
Purpose: the CEO's input to the Friday board meeting (the Chief of Staff writes the report at 14:00). Source: the CEO's Friday routine.

Follow 'Friday board meeting' in your instructions.
schedules.definition_of_done: A note 'Board <week>: CEO' exists and the Chief of Staff has its link.

note: Top of the chain of command: the only agent that contacts the owner (the Chief of Staff's digest and weekly report, the Hlídač's critical incidents and the Access manager's digest are the named exceptions). Runs in the agent pool.
